lead_raw_text:
The structure of Hf2Mg12Zr2 (reduced formula HfMg6Zr) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: each Hf, Mg, and Zr atom has 12 geometric neighbors, with Mg environments containing varying Mg, Hf, and Zr neighbor counts. The neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra connected through corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts, including corner- and edge-sharing between Hf- and Mg-centered polyhedra.
